LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - A R G U E D; ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE WHY A PRELIMINARY INJUNCTION SHOULD NOT ISSUE - PLAINTIFFS ARE ENTITLED TO PARTIAL RELIEF BY WAY OF PRELIMINARY INJUNCTION. AFL 11-32 MAY BE ENFORCED EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE MONTHLY REPORTING REQUIREMENT AND SUBJECT TO THE COURT'S FINAL DETERMINATION WHETHER IT IS APPROPRIATE TO ENJOIN ENFORCEMENT WITH RESPECT TO THE THREE CATEGORIES ENUMERATED AT THE HEARING (SPINAL FUSION, CESAREAN SECTION & PACEMAKER SURGERY). THE COURT CONTINUED THE MATTER TO JULY 6, 2011 AND DEEMED SUBMITTED ON THAT DATE. THE COURT ALLOWED THE PARTIES TO SUBMIT BRIEFS ON THE ISSUE WHETHER IT IS APPROPRIATE TO ENJOIN ENFORCEMENT AS TO THOSE THREE CATEGORIES. PLAINTIFFS TO SUBMIT BRIEFING ON THAT ISSUE BY JUNE 27, 2011. DEFENDANT TO FILE A RESPONSE BY JUNE 30, 2011. REPLY TO BE FILED BY JULY 6, 2011 AND DEEMED IT SUBMITTED ON THAT DATE. EACH SIDE TO SUBMIT FORM OF ORDER FOR THE COURT'S CONSIDERATION ELECTRONICALLY AS MICROSFOT WORD.DOC FILE. PER DIEM FEES ASSESSED BY THE COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER, CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB

LAW AND MOTION 301, RULING - THE MATTER WAS NOT ARGUED. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: THE SOCIETY FOR HEALTHCARE EPIDEMIOLGY (SHEA)'S APPLICATION OF AMICUS CURIAE TO FILE BRIEF IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR INJUNCTIVE RELIEF IS GRANTED. MOVING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER, CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB
